title: Preserve canonical semantic runtime data across Staging rebuilds

phases.objective: Make canonical runtime seeds replayable, classify every changed migration by Git diff, and fail closed on missing exact readback without accessing a live environment.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Runtime lifecycle CI guard and portable Staging schema bundle
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A schema-only rebuild plan includes the canonical Platform Admin and WordPress deployment authority seeds, requires exact-one readback, and rejects unclassified numeric or dated migration mutations.
steps: Select every changed SQL migration from the base-to-head Git diff regardless of filename convention.
Classify each runtime data mutation and reject unclassified, operational reseed, or non-replayable canonical writes.
Build the isolated Staging schema bundle with both canonical seed files.
Require exact-one readback for the Platform Admin workspace, WordPress command, admin tool, and execution policy.
Keep live Staging certification required and Production mutation forbidden.

Before any direct schema-only import mutation, census all three local Staging role databases and refuse the direct importer if any role is non-empty; partial-role recovery remains exclusively governed by Rebuild-EmptyStagingRoleDatabases.
Reject destructive SQL in canonical seed replay, including DELETE, TRUNCATE, REPLACE, DROP object statements, table rename, and ALTER TABLE DROP.

Classify workspace_registry canonical mutations only when they originate from the registered canonical seed file and prove an exact row selector; comments, broad writes, and wrong-file mutations fail closed.
Read back Platform Admin cardinality with the same ready canonical marker predicate used by the runtime resolver, in addition to exact seed identity.
Keep Staging full inspection on the Windows/Docker local handoff with database.inspect + dry_run and no GitHub broker dependency or database mutation.
Keep database.rebuild_empty restricted to same-cycle zero-object role evidence, verified local request/ticket bindings, exact typed confirmation, and same-cycle required-table readback.
Approve only exact line-scoped context-kernel scanner findings for the canonical Platform Admin authority identities declared in the lifecycle contract and seed migration.
Bind in-place canonical semantic repair to a versioned artifact registry with exact source path, SHA256, statement count, target role, replay modes, and fail-closed conflict policy.
Allow canonical semantic repair on an existing non-empty Runtime schema only when the relevant canonical identity/candidate set is absent, while preserving unrelated runtime rows.
Bind every repair plan to the exact repository commit, lifecycle contract hash, semantic artifact registry hash, migration manifest hash, semantic precondition fingerprint, and target role.
Treat any mutation transport failure or unverified postcondition as reconciliation_required with mutation retry disabled until independent readback.
Keep managed Git child processes hermetic against hostile host EOL and credential-helper configuration while preserving non-force push and credential zeroization.
Execute the registered canonical artifact only through the repository-owned transaction path; callers cannot inject SQL, an artifact executor, a target role, or a target environment.
Re-derive typed confirmation from the immutable plan hash at apply time and reject repository, environment, role, or execution-authority drift before mutation.

Reserve each repair plan exactly once in a durable secret-free ledger outside the Runtime target data before mutation; process interruption leaves an executing or unknown_outcome record that requires reconciliation.
Expose explicit plan/apply/reconcile commands that require the exact checkout SHA, original immutable plan file, local Staging target, and durable ledger directory.
Emit one secret-free completeness report across canonical, environment, and operational datasets; unresolved replay debt remains blocking evidence rather than being hidden by workspace readiness.
Run the hostile Git transport, durable ledger, operational CLI, and completeness report contracts on a focused windows-latest lane.
assertions: Numeric and date-prefixed changed migrations are both inspected.
Canonical seeds are present in the role manifest and portable bundle.
All four canonical identities require exactly one matching row.
No database, provider, Staging, or Production mutation occurs in this journey.
Direct schema replay cannot write over a non-empty local Staging role database.
Canonical seed replay is fail-closed against destructive data or schema operations.
A canonical identity token in a comment or broad UPDATE cannot classify a mixed-table mutation as canonical.
A second ready workspace matching any resolver canonical marker makes resolver-equivalent cardinality readback fail.
host-breakglass:local --help performs no request parsing, workflow dispatch, or database mutation and reports the Windows/Docker inspection contract.
GitHub broker configuration failure is independent of local Runtime DB diagnosis and preserves github_app_auth_missing_installation_id as its cause code.
Non-empty role databases cannot enter database.rebuild_empty, and mutation paths remain ticket-, confirmation-, and same-cycle-readback-gated.
Context-kernel hardcoding exceptions remain line-scoped to canonical authority data; runtime tests derive the identity from the registered contract instead of duplicating customer-like literals.
A non-empty Runtime database with workspace_registry present but no Platform Admin candidate can produce an in-place repair plan without entering schema rebuild.
Acknowledgement proves review of one exact immutable repair plan and is never execution authority.
Artifact/contract/manifest/precondition drift invalidates the repair plan before mutation.
Unknown mutation outcome never auto-retries; reconciliation readback is the only allowed next state.
Canonical UPDATE payloads cannot mutate workspace identity columns even when the WHERE selector is exact.
Managed Git remains LF-deterministic under hostile global core.autocrlf/core.eol settings and never force-pushes.
Canonical semantic repair wraps only the registry-verified statements in START TRANSACTION/COMMIT and attempts ROLLBACK before entering reconciliation_required.
Changing required_confirmation, expected_repository, target_environment, target_role, or execution authority cannot authorize apply.
A consumed repair plan cannot be applied again, and unknown outcome can transition only through explicit reconciliation to succeeded.
The operational CLI refuses Production/Hostinger targets and cannot regenerate a replacement plan during apply or reconciliation.
Canonical completeness cannot be true while any canonical_registry dataset has unresolved replay debt or lacks a ready readback.
Windows portability tests use SHA-pinned GitHub Actions and do not receive write permissions or persisted checkout credentials.

phases.objective: Run separately authorized live Staging rebuild certification and exact semantic readback.
Expand required-key replay manifests to every historical canonical registry family and keep destructive/non-empty rebuild paths fail-closed.
No live canary is authorized by this repository-only change.
